flows.title: Create a dashboard
steps: In the top right of the screen, click + New > Dashboard.
Give the dashboard a name and a description, and choose the collection it goes in.
Click Create. Metabase opens the new dashboard.
To put a chart on it, click the + icon in the top right while editing, and add a new question, a SQL query or an existing question.

flows.title: Ask a question with the query builder
steps: From the + New dropdown, select Question.
Pick the data to work with: a table from a database, a model, a metric or another saved question. Type to search, or browse databases and collections.
Add filters to restrict the data, for example Widgets over the last 3 weeks.
Summarize it, for example as a count of rows or the average of a column, and group the summary by a dimension if needed.
Click the Preview button to the right of a step to see the first 10 rows of results up to that step.

flows.title: Add a database connection
steps: Click the grid icon in the top right and select Admin.
In Admin settings, go to Databases > Add a database.
Fill out the fields for that database, which differ from one database to another, and click Save changes at the bottom.
